cuerpo.name: Taison v1.3.0
cuerpo.body:
### Taison v1.3.0 is here! Now caught up with Mihon v0.20.1 — two new trackers, the reworked extension store, and a vertical chapter navigator for the reader.

> [!NOTE]
>
> ### Extensions may show as "Orphaned" (previously "Obsolete") right after updating
>
> Extension stores carried over from v1.2.x are read from the retired index until the app refreshes them, which it does automatically once a day — so your installed extensions can appear as "Orphaned" with a warning suggesting you uninstall them. **Don't uninstall anything.** Your extensions still work, and it clears itself within 24 hours.
>
> To clear it right away: refresh in `Settings › Browse › Extension stores`, then pull down to refresh on the `Browse › Extensions` tab. Both steps are needed — the first updates the store, the second reloads the extension list.

# 🔄 Synced with Mihon v0.19.9 → v0.20.1

Everything below comes from upstream [Mihon](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon) and is credited to its original authors.

## ✨ Added
- [Hikka](https://hikka.io/) tracker support ([@Lorg0n](https://github.com/Lorg0n)) ([#1386](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/1386))
  - Fix Hikka not defaulting to "Plan to Read" for unread titles ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3534](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3534))
  - Fix Hikka search throwing error due to unclosed response ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3548](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3548))
- Add support for [MangaBaka](https://mangabaka.org) tracker ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3047](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3047))
- Add support for `tachiyomix` 1.6 extensions ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich))
- Add support for `tachiyomix` extension index format ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3349](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3349))
- Add vertical chapter navigator for long strip mode ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3377](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3377))
- Add setting to control vertical chapter navigator height ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3528](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3528))
- Add option to set which readers use vertical chapter navigator ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3528](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3528))
- Display authors and description in Shikimori search results ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3499](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3499))
- Invalidate download cache after backup restore ([@leodyversemilla07](https://github.com/leodyversemilla07)) ([#3096](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3096))
- Add option to open app settings from system settings ([@JFronny](https://github.com/JFronny)) ([#3180](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3180))

## 🔧 Changed
- Change the term "extension repo" to "extension store" ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3349](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3349))
- Change the term "Obsolete" to "Orphaned" for extensions ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3383](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3383))
- Remove text limit of manga notes ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3410](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3410))
- Tweak Catppuccin color scheme for clarity ([@xenitane](https://github.com/xenitane)) ([#3436](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3436))
- Update app shortcuts to use app icon color scheme ([@NGB-Was-Taken](https://github.com/NGB-Was-Taken)) ([#2835](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/2835))
- Don't use GMS to detect if GMS is available ([@leodyversemilla07](https://github.com/leodyversemilla07)) ([#3525](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3525))

## 🚀 Improved
- Show usernames in Tracking settings ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3533](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3533))
- Batch database operations during backup restore for improved performance ([@Lolle2000la](https://github.com/Lolle2000la)) ([#3267](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3267))

## 🐛 Fixed
- Fix Shikimori tracking not working ([@MajorTanya](https://github.com/MajorTanya)) ([#3497](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3497))
- Fix crash trying to select text in notes screen ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3516](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3516))
- Fix crash when putting app in background ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3523](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3523))
- Fix support for non-system SAF providers ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3530](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3530))
- Fix chapter's `memo` field not being updated for existing chapters ([@cuong-tran](https://github.com/cuong-tran)) ([#3538](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3538))
- Fix app not reading `tachiyomix.extensionLib` extension metadata ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3545](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3545), [#3559](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3559))
- Fix reader navigator slider steps not updating after changing chapter ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3549](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3549))
- Add missing `outlineVariant` color to Nord theme ([@CompileConnected](https://github.com/CompileConnected)) ([#3184](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3184))
- Continue reading button missing when unread filter is off ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich)) ([#3382](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3382))
- Fix random `FileNotFoundException` when reading chapters ([@leodyversemilla07](https://github.com/leodyversemilla07)) ([#3154](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/pull/3154))
- Fix regression with installing/updating extensions ([@AntsyLich](https://github.com/AntsyLich))

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with taison-v1.3.0.apk

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.2.3
cuerpo.body:
Check out the [past release notes](https://github.com/Gent8/Taison/releases) if you're upgrading from an earlier version.

## Taison v1.2.3

A mini release — direct entry sharing between Taison users and themed icon support.

### ✨ New
- Share entries directly with other Taison users.
- Themed icon and adaptive icon support ([#8](https://github.com/Gent8/Taison/issues/8)).

### 🔧 Changed
- Synced Taison with Mihon v0.19.9 (includes the Mihon v0.19.8 and v0.19.9 changes).

Collections are in the works and coming soon ([#3](https://github.com/Gent8/Taison/issues/3)).

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `taison-v1.2.3.apk`

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.2.2
cuerpo.body:
Check out the [past release notes](https://github.com/Gent8/Taison/releases) if you're upgrading from an earlier version.

## Highlights
- Synced Taison with Mihon v0.19.7.
- Includes the Mihon v0.19.5 and v0.19.6 fixes since Taison v1.2.1.
- Mihon v0.19.7 is a rerelease of v0.19.6 with the proper version bump.

### Fixes
- Fix app crashing when trying to add extension repo with existing signature.
- Potentially fix "database is locked" crash.
- Fix occasional crash when mass installing/uninstalling extensions using PackageManager.
- Fix app crash on startup on some Android TV.

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `taison-v1.2.2.apk`

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.2.1
cuerpo.body:
### Taison
- Sync with Mihon v0.19.4.

### Mihon
- Added filter options to the Updates tab.
- Added bookmarked chapters to chapter download options.
- Added `src:` search support in Library, including `src:local`.
- Improved tracked library duplicate detection.
- Improved tracked library filter performance.
- Automatic library updates now run even when connected to a VPN.
- Fixed extension install/update getting stuck at pending.
- Fixed migration dialog and selected-source issues.
- Fixed crashes around Shizuku extension install/update in some cases.
- Fixed several reader, history, and tracker-related issues.

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `taison-v1.2.1.apk`

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.2.0
cuerpo.body: ### Taison v1.2.0 is here! With new library grouping options and refined controls, navigation feels more organized than ever. ## ✨ Added - **Group library filtering** for categories, sources, status, and ungrouped items ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Mature-content filter** in Library ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Category visibility toggle** (`Settings › Categories`) to hide/show categories ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Editable default category name**, with the option to hide it ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Trust all extensions** action in Browse ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Graphic banner** for the Taison theme in Settings ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). ## 🔧 Changed - Category input fields now **place the cursor at the end** on create/edit ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - Renamed **“Category navigation type” → “Navigation type”** in Settings ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - Updated several **category-related strings** for consistency ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - Removed **Navigation type** option from `Library › Filter › Display` ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). ## 🚀 Improved - Replaced **HorizontalPager** with **AnimatedContent** in the drawer for smoother transitions ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). > [!TIP] > > ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with taison-v1.2.0.apk

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.1.0
cuerpo.body: ## ✨ Added - **History category navigation** (`Settings › Library › Enable category navigation in History`) mirrors the Library tabs/dropdown inside History; switching categories in either screen stays in sync. It can only be toggled if **Scope history to respective category** is enabled ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - **Toolbar eye toggle** in History to include or hide entries outside the library, with disabled, active, and inactive states ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). This addresses the issue of non-library entries only being visible in the default category. Resolves #1 - **Scoped history deletion** option in the History delete dialog so you can clear just the active category / non-library entries or wipe everything ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). ## 🔧 Changed - Replaced the old “show category tabs at top” boolean with **Category navigation type**, a picker (dropdown vs tabs) found in Settings ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). - Updated text for the scoped-history setting to **“Scope history to respective category”** (previously “active category”) for clarity ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). ## 🚀 Improvements - History filter logic now keeps uncategorized favorites separate from non-library items, and filtering respects the **include non-library entries** toggle ([@Gent8](https://github.com/Gent8)). > [!TIP] > > ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `taison-v1.1.0.apk`

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.0.1
cuerpo.body:
## Highlights
- Upstream sync to Mihon v0.19.3, bringing all fixes and dependency bumps from the past month.

## Upstream fixes included:

### 🚀 Improvements
- Enhanced various aspects of WebView multi-window support to improve stability and performance. (@TheUnlocked)

### 🧹 Removals
- Reverted the change “Fix reader tap zones triggering after scrolling was stopped by the user” due to a regression it introduced. (@AntsyLich)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed a WebView crash introduced in version 0.19.2. (@bapeey)
- Fixed an issue where extra padding appeared in the reader after user interactions. (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed an issue where the long strip reader would not scroll on consecutive taps. (@AntsyLich)

> [!TIP]
>
> ### If you are unsure which version to download then go with `taison-v1.0.1.apk`

cuerpo.name: Taison v1.0.0
cuerpo.body:
### Added
- Advanced setting to limit download filenames to ASCII characters...
- Option to scope history entries to the active library category. (Taison specific)

### Changed
- Delegate Suwayomi tracker authentication to extension. 
- Added an option to switch the Library tab category selector from tab-based navigation to a popover menu accessible from the header. (Taison specific)
- Taison theme is now default; Classic Blue lives on as an option. (Taison specific)
- Rebranded launcher, user agents, and docs to `com.gent8.taison`.

### Improved
- Spoof `X-Requested-With` headers for newer WebView versions.
- Allow distinct downloads when chapter metadata collides.

### Fixed
- Description height when images are present.
- Migration progress when searching manually.
- Category migration flag checks and incognito toggle notification.
